name: Saitama

flag.description: A ring of sixteen red curved jewels (magatama) on a white field.
flag.symbolism: The magatama, ancient comma-shaped jewels, stand for sakimitama, the blessing spirit the name Saitama is said to come from; their ring stands for the sun, growth and passion.

hook: Saitama's red ring on white is sixteen magatama jewels, and the 玉 (tama) in Saitama means "jewel".
trivia: The capital, Saitama City, is written in hiragana (さいたま) rather than kanji.
The Sakitama Kofun burial mounds gave the prefecture its name.
